methods: manual per-file source logic inspection; SDK/backend wires cross-checked using local repository source
durable isolated regression tests added before fixes; pre-fix failing outputs saved
full pre-edit baseline and final module gates; targeted race tests; no deployment/real-service execution

findings.title: Credential overwrites retained public permissions and followed leaf symlinks
findings.before_result: FAIL on production behavior before fix
findings.fix: Create same-directory 0600 temporary file, close, atomically rename; cleanup temporary file on all paths.

findings.title: Auth login/logout persisted one-shot profile selection
findings.before_result: FAIL on production behavior before fix
findings.fix: Factory.SaveConfig restores the persisted default when an override is active; auth mutators use it. Intentional profile use still uses config.Save.

findings.title: Credential deletion errors were swallowed while refs/profile were removed
findings.before_result: FAIL on production behavior before fix
findings.fix: Delete all referenced credentials successfully before saving removal; preserve refs on failures and return typed local.keychain_denied.

findings.title: Confirmation retry argv lost selected profile
findings.before_result: FAIL on production behavior before fix
findings.fix: Pin the resolved profile for both single and batch confirmation retry argv without mutating caller slices.

findings.title: Text dry-run returned internal error instead of plan
findings.before_result: FAIL on production behavior before fix
findings.fix: Normalize text and ndjson dry-run output to the documented single JSON plan envelope; retain caller format options.

findings.title: Document wait treated cancelled parsing as nonterminal
findings.before_result: FAIL on production behavior before fix
findings.fix: Classify backend parse_status=cancelled as failed terminal result with restart hint; return exit 1 instead of waiting until timeout.

findings.title: Agent skeleton command required authenticated SDK initialization
findings.before_result: FAIL on production behavior before fix
findings.fix: Emit the offline YAML skeleton before client construction/model resolution.

findings.title: Doctor reused cached version from a different server
findings.before_result: FAIL on production behavior before fix
findings.fix: Persist normalized host in cached Info and require exact server identity match; legacy cache without host is not reused for production keyed services.

findings.title: Confirmation retry dropped DELETE body and model-update options
findings.before_result: FAIL on production behavior before fix
findings.fix: Use existing body-preserving API retry builder for DELETE; include repeated params and stdin key-rotation flag for model update. Secret stdin contents remain unread until approved execution.

findings.title: Login misclassified forbidden/rate-limit/server failures as bad credentials
findings.before_result: FAIL on production behavior before fix
findings.fix: Only map 401 to auth.bad_credential; retain HTTP classification for 403/429/5xx for both API-key and password login.

findings.title: Stateless environment credentials were blocked by broken local config
findings.before_result: FAIL on production behavior before fix
findings.fix: With active environment credential and explicit GENYEE_HOST, status and doctor do not require profile config; status labels auth source and profile as environment.

findings.title: Doctor discarded output projection failures and exited successfully
findings.before_result: FAIL on production behavior before fix
findings.fix: Return JSON output/projection error through command RunE; syntactically valid jq runtime error now fails instead of silent success.

ruled_out.topic: has_more on single fetched server page
ruled_out.reason: Existing chunk help explicitly defines has_more as --limit truncation; TestChunkList_HasMoreReportsActualLimitTruncation requires false for a page-only window. Trial changes/tests were removed from doc/session/search/chunk; production pagination unchanged.
Public command rejects blank/control arguments before schema resolution; TestSchemaRejectsBlankCommandWithoutPanic passes without source change.
Invalid syntax already rejected by CheckFormatFlag; the confirmed defect is a syntactically valid jq runtime projection error, separately reproduced.

limits: No live deployment, external API, real credentials/keyring or real user-data operations were used. Existing repository acceptance tests are fixture-based.
All 140 non-test Go source files inspected. Existing test bodies were selectively inspected; the entire CLI test suite was executed. This is not a formal proof that all defects are absent.
Backend implementations and SDK are outside this module edit scope; prior SDK audit is separate client-sdk.json.
FileStore fix protects credential file inode permissions and leaf symlink replacement; it does not claim hostile parent-directory protection or cross-process credential transactions.
Credential cleanup can be partially completed if a later delete fails; retained on-disk refs make retries possible, since stores treat missing entries as no-op.
Doctor keeps one cache file and re-probes on host change; no claim of multi-host cache retention. Text renderer writer-error handling beyond the reproduced JSON projection issue remains unchanged.
Normal status/check commands intentionally return reachable=false rather than an SDK error, consistent with existing module tests; not redefined here.

Some descriptive skill prose is historically broader than implementation (e.g. blanket explicit --kb language); current executable code and pinned tests were used to avoid speculative semantic changes.
